name: Fairycore
reacts_against: cottagecore's grounded rural practicality, tilting toward the fantastical and otherworldly instead.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Fairy wings, sparkles, glitter, mushrooms, butterflies, flowers, moss, soft animals, elf ears
wiki_facts.key_colours: Pastel colours, earth tones, soft greens, pinks, and yellows
wiki_facts.key_values: Magic, nature, tranquility, escapism, optimism, kindness

findings: mostly muted — about 50% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
